column1: completed  the  qualifications  in  Section  14(a)  of  the  Service  Minute  No.1070/13  of
11.03.1990 and they will be promoted as from the date they complete other qualifications
excluding the one referred to in 10.1.1 (VIII).

column2: Should have completed at least seven (07) years of active and satisfactory period
of  service  in  Grade  III  of  the  category  of  service  and  earned  seven  (07)  salary
increments as at the date of qualifying for promotion.
Should  have  demonstrated  a  performance  at  satisfactory  level  or  above  during
seven  (07)  years  immediately  preceding  the  date  of  promotion  in  accordance
with the approved procedure of performance appraisal.
